system.description: Where rest costs at least 10 zenit, you have access to at least one shop connected to a secret network, selling up to three items priced up to 500 zenit above your party's suggested maximum item value. The rest-cost gate is a wealth gate, and here a geography gate: ten-zenit lodging is the West End and the coaching inns, so the black market is uptown. Houndsditch trades in what was stolen; this trades in what was imported. It never sells hoplospheres — the jeweller's window is the sanctioned channel, and a criminal channel that could order spheres would break "you cannot buy the one you need".
